source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one independently authored, randomized, complex photorealistic full-body test image in the assigned industrial motion-capture rehearsal lane, using the supplied portrait only for adult facial, hair, and general-appearance guidance, so that a later disclosed wardrobe keyword can be judged from visible pixels.
subject: One clearly adult woman with long dark softly waved hair rehearsing alone in fitted performance wardrobe of deliberately unspecified topology.
setting: An industrial motion-capture rehearsal volume threaded between tall suspended translucent fabric panels, steel rigging, taped floor coordinates, and calibrated practical lights.
event: She holds a controlled diagonal rehearsal stride with one arm reaching across a hanging panel gap while optical tracking markers record the motion.
visual_priorities: The upper garment, waist, crotch/rise, both fitted legs, leg openings/hems, and full silhouette must all remain clearly inspectable in one frame.
Wardrobe topology is deliberately unspecified in this frozen core, leaving whether the fitted performance wardrobe is one-piece or separated open for the post-core target contract.
Suspended panels and tracking markers function as scene elements while the adult performer's anatomy, garment boundaries, and floor contact remain visually legible.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a complex photorealistic full-body fashion-performance photograph of one clearly adult woman with long dark softly waved hair rehearsing alone in fitted performance wardrobe of deliberately unspecified topology. She holds a controlled diagonal rehearsal stride with one arm reaching across a hanging panel gap inside an industrial motion-capture volume of steel rigging, taped floor coordinates, calibrated practical lights, and tall suspended translucent fabric panels. Small optical tracking markers register the motion while angled cool work lights and a warm floor bounce reveal realistic fabric tension, skin texture, and depth through the panel layers. Frame her from head to both grounded feet with a three-quarter frontal viewpoint and enough breathing room around every contour. The upper garment, waist, crotch/rise, both fitted legs, leg openings/hems, and full silhouette must all remain clearly inspectable in one frame. Keep every panel edge spatially separate from garment boundaries and place tracking markers as clearly raised dots rather than apparent stitching. Use the supplied portrait only as adult facial, hair, and general-appearance guidance for this new fictional scene.
